d:
A series of pictures originally made for a side gallery in the creator's free game based on Mass Effect. They make the bulk of his Patreon content beyond progress updates and WIPs for comics and games. Only 18 pictures actually made it into the final game (but in semi-animated form), but he's still making "Gallery pics" even after for fun (like the KOF ones celebrating XV's release).

Support the creator!: https://www.patreon.com/reddy
https://www.patreon.com/PowerReddy
UPDATE: Due to being banned from Patreon, the artist can now be found on Deviantart and Itch.io:
https://www.deviantart.com/reddyheart2004
https://reddyheart.itch.io

Mass Attraction (the free game some of these pics are in): http://reddypics.com/game/
FemShep mode: http://www.reddypics.com/jane/
Futa edition: http://reddypics.com/futa/
(be aware it's Futa-on-Male; the creator plans on make a Futa FemShep edition at some point, but is working on a different project currently to avoid burning out)
